text:
anya: spotted a weird helper process 'runc-svc' inside prod-infer-02 at ~14:07 UTC. Not restarting the pod, tagging oncall.
ben: +1 don't restart. Collect /proc/<pid>/cmdline and environ, and do a container inspect; snapshot node logs if possible.
carmen: Also verify image digest and attestation: `crane manifest ${REG}/repo@sha256:...` then `cosign verify --keyless ${REG}/repo@sha256:...`. If verify fails, treat as tamper.
dev-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-1103. Artifacts archived to s3://redwood-incidents/SEC-2026-1103/ (pod-logs.gz, node-metrics.tar).
nisha: Oncall here. I'll correlate KMS envelope and signer events, and check when the signing key was used. Who pulled the image and which SA? @oscar can you list registry pulls for that digest?
oscar: Registry: digest sha256:bb77d4... shows pulls by inferer-service@prod at 13:50 from 2 nodes and a pull by ci-scan@ci at 02:10. No pushes. I'll export token mint events and auth logs in ~8m.
pat: If attestation missing, revoke the short-lived registry token used by the service and rotate any mounted keystores. I'll open a quick RBAC PR to limit who can mint registry tokens for prod.
quinn: Rebuild playbook: minimal base rebuild -> run staging smoke -> cosign resign using KMS signing key -> canary rollout with traffic ramp. Hold full-prod deploy to scheduled window unless we confirm active exploit.
anya: Action list: (1) ben to gather proc dumps + container inspect (2) oscar to provide pull/token audit (3) nisha to correlate KMS/sign events and propose rotations if needed (4) quinn/pat to prepare rebuild/RBAC PR. Keep updates concise here so incident timeline is easy to build. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
